evidence: The stoichiometry and the contamination (H, OH and C) of as-deposited and N2 annealed thick Al2O3 layers were characterized by secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS), elastic recoil detection analysis (ERDA) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). We show a perturbed region (/C255n m thick) at the Al2O3/Si interface by XPS and Auger electron spectrometry (AES). Angle resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (ARXPS) was performed using an SSI S-Probe spectrometer...
